focus.0: The urge will pass. Your identity won't. Choose who you're becoming.
focus.1: Dopamine reset is not about willpower — it's about rebuilding your reward circuit one day at a time.
focus.2: Every hour you hold means your brain is rewiring. The discomfort is the progress.
focus.3: You didn't come this far to only come this far. The streak is the proof.
focus.4: Cravings peak at 20 minutes. Outlast them — you always have before.
focus.5: The version of you who quit is still watching. Don't let them down today.
focus.6: Boredom is not an emergency. Sit with it. That's where the rewiring happens.
focus.7: Recovery isn't a straight line, but every clean day moves the baseline up.
focus.8: What you resist persists. Acknowledge the urge, then let it pass like weather.
focus.9: Your future self is being built right now, in this exact moment of resistance.
focus.10: Discipline is remembering what you want most over what you want right now.
focus.11: The brain that got you here can heal. Give it the silence it needs today.
focus.12: One decision away from a relapse, one decision away from your best day. Choose.
focus.13: Showing up on the hard days is what separates a streak from a lifestyle.

coldPage.title: Cold Exposure
coldPage.subtitle: 2 minutes of guided breathing for the cold shower.
coldPage.subtitleAccent: Do this when the urge hits hardest.
coldPage.dopamineResetDesc: Cold water triggers a 2.5× spike in dopamine — longer-lasting than any substance. It's the cleanest high your brain can produce.
coldPage.urgeSuppressorDesc: The cold shock overrides the craving signal in your prefrontal cortex. You can't feel an urge and cold shock at the same time.
coldPage.willpowerTrainingDesc: Every time you choose discomfort on purpose, you strengthen the same neural pathway that resists bad habits. One cold shower = one rep.
coldPage.step1: Step in. Don't brace — let the water hit your chest directly.
coldPage.step2: Inhale for 4 seconds through your nose. Slow and controlled.
coldPage.step3: Exhale slowly for 6 seconds through your mouth. Let the shock pass.
coldPage.step4: After 60 seconds, turn your back to the stream. You've earned it.
coldPage.step5: At 90 seconds, breathe normally. Scan your body — feel the calm arrive.
coldPage.step6: At 2 minutes — step out. You just rewired a stress response.
coldPage.scienceText: Cold exposure raises norepinephrine by up to 300%. This is the same neurotransmitter responsible for focus, mood, and impulse control — the exact things addiction depletes.
